lag2-weighted injury anchor for rushing QBs (0.7*lag2+0.3*ep17)

add lag2_carries+lag3_carries to QB features: MAE improved (74.7) but rank_penalty worse (31.4), Maye exploded to #26, Mahomes worse (#78), within noise floor

QB scarcity 0.52 + pocket penalty 0.82: mean improvement 0.65 across seeds 42/99 — below cross-seed noise floor ~1.3; rankings improved (Daniels target, Goff target) but Allen/Mahomes still too low
lower LR 5e-4: underfits at 150 epochs, QB MAE 76.2->77.0, Dart #117, rank_penalty 65.9

add prev_fpts_per_game to QB features: tiny MAE gain (76.2->76.0) but Goff drops to #159 (over-penalized via 0.82x), rank_penalty 17.2->18.6, net -0.16 below noise floor

add rush_yards_per_game to QB features: QB MAE 76.2->75.3 (great!), but Daniels drops #51->58 (anchor not compensating), rank_penalty 17.2->18.6; net 0.85 below noise floor; need to bundle with stronger Daniels correction

bundle rush_yards_per_game + stronger Daniels anchor (0.85/0.15): seed42=75.81 (1.25 improvement) but seed99=76.66 (1.46 WORSE than baseline 75.20); cross-seed mean 76.24 > baseline 76.13; cross-seed variance washes gain
remove lag3_fantasy_ppr: QB MAE 76.2->74.6 (great) but seed99=76.77 (vs baseline 75.20); cross-seed means equal (76.135 vs 76.130); rank variance too high — lag3 stabilizes training
rush tier 1.18->1.22x for rush_score>=600: seed42=77.34 (worse!), seed99=75.19; mean 76.265 > baseline 76.13; boosts Lamar/Maye equally so no relative Allen gain; rank_penalty 22.9 (worse)
MC samples 50->100: seed42=77.51 (WORSE), seed99=75.30; mean 76.41 worse than baseline 76.13; more samples converge to true lower mean for Allen (#40 seed42), worsening rankings
VOR scarcity 0.52->0.58: seed42=76.88 (+0.18), seed99=74.94 (+0.26); consistent direction but mean improvement 0.22 < noise floor 0.93; rank_penalty 17.2->13.7 (seed42), ~24->18.9 (seed99)

bundle: scarcity 0.58 + rush_yards_per_game + Daniels anchor 0.85; seed42=75.70 (+1.36!) seed99=76.36 (-1.16); cross-seed mean 76.03 (only 0.10 improvement); rush_yds_per_game consistently helps seed42, hurts seed99
weight_decay 1e-4->5e-4: seed42=76.95 (+0.11), seed99=75.12 (+0.08); consistent direction but mean improvement 0.095 below noise floor; both seeds improved slightly

weight_decay 5e-4 + rush_yards_per_game: seed42=76.27 (+0.79 MAE) but seed99=77.12 (-1.92, Daniels #64, MAE 75.6 WORSE!); rush_yards_per_game affects MAE oppositely per seed — not reliably learnable in 150 epochs

scarcity 0.52->0.58 + weight_decay 1e-4->5e-4: seed42=76.80 (+0.26), seed99=74.90 (+0.30); cross-seed mean 75.85 beats baseline 76.13; consistent improvement both seeds; Daniels #49 Allen #26 Mahomes #57 rank_penalty 12.2

scarcity 0.58->0.65: seed42=76.75 (+0.05), seed99=74.79 (+0.11); cross-seed mean 75.77 vs 75.85 (+0.08); Goff drops to #125 (rushing QBs gain VOR more proportionally); Allen #24 Mahomes #53 rank_penalty 11.2
scarcity 0.65->0.75: seed42=76.65 (+0.10), seed99=74.37 (+0.42); cross-seed mean 75.51 vs 75.77 (+0.26); Allen #20 (s42) #15 (s99), Mahomes below-target no penalty; rank_penalty 9.2 (s42) 8.6 (s99)
scarcity 0.75->0.85: seed42=76.63 (+0.02), seed99=74.25 (+0.12); mean 75.44 (+0.07); Allen #18 s42 #14 s99; rank_penalty 8.9/6.1; diminishing returns
scarcity 0.85->0.95: IDENTICAL to Exp 34 — metric plateaued; scarcity 0.85 already saturates VOR ordering; no change in rank or primary
Daniels anchor w_lag2=0.85 for games<8: cross-seed improvement only 0.05 (75.39 vs 75.44) — below noise floor; seed42 unchanged at 76.63, seed99 +0.10 (74.15)
ultra-elite rush tier >=900: 1.23x — cross-seed mean 75.43 vs 75.44 (-0.01); rank_penalty 9.1/5.5 s42/s99; injury correction cancels Daniels boost; Allen rank barely improves
